```python
"""SQLite access: connections, the ``get_db`` dependency and schema migrations.

The application uses the standard library's :mod:`sqlite3` directly. There is
no ORM: queries are short and explicit, and every value goes through a ``?``
placeholder so that user input can never change the meaning of a statement.

Connections
-----------
Endpoints never open connections. They declare a dependency::

    @router.get("/things")
    def list_things(conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)):
        rows = conn.execute("SELECT id, name FROM things").fetchall()

``get_db`` hands out a connection whose rows are :class:`sqlite3.Row` objects
(columns readable by name, ``row["name"]``) and with foreign keys enforced. The
work done during one request is committed when the endpoint returns normally
and rolled back if it raises.

Migrations
----------
The schema is defined by :data:`MIGRATIONS`, a list of SQL scripts applied in
order. The number of scripts already applied is stored in SQLite's
``user_version`` pragma, so :func:`init_db` only runs the new ones. To change
the schema, **append** a script; never edit or reorder the existing entries,
because databases in use have already run them.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
import threading
from collections.abc import Iterator
from datetime import datetime, timezone

#: Schema scripts, applied in order. Append only.
MIGRATIONS: list[str] = [
    # 1: users. ``username`` is unique without regard to case, so "Alice" and
    # "alice" cannot both register.
    """
    CREATE TABLE users (
        id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        username      TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,
        password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,
        created_at    TEXT    NOT NULL
    );
    """,
    # 2: an audit trail of security-relevant events (sign-ins, failed sign-ins).
    """
    CREATE TABLE audit_log (
        id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        user_id    INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        event      TEXT    NOT NULL,
        detail     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        created_at TEXT    NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE INDEX audit_log_user ON audit_log(user_id, created_at);
    """,
    # 3: personal todo lists. Each todo belongs to one user.
    """
    CREATE TABLE todos (
        id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        user_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        title       TEXT    NOT NULL,
        done        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at  TEXT    NOT NULL,
        updated_at  TEXT    NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE INDEX todos_user ON todos(user_id, created_at DESC);
    """,
]


def utc_now() -> str:
    """The current time in UTC as an ISO 8601 string, e.g. ``2026-11-24T12:00:00+00:00``.

    All timestamps are stored in this form. Strings in this format sort in the
    same order as the times they represent, so ``ORDER BY created_at`` works.
    """
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def connect(path: str) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Open a connection configured the way the application expects.

    * rows are :class:`sqlite3.Row`, so columns can be read by name;
    * foreign key constraints are enforced (SQLite leaves them off by default);
    * ``check_same_thread`` is off because FastAPI may run a request's
      dependencies and endpoint in different worker threads. Each connection is
      still used by one request at a time.
    """
    conn = sqlite3.connect(path, check_same_thread=False)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    return conn


def schema_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
    """How many entries of :data:`MIGRATIONS` have been applied to this database."""
    return int(conn.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0])


def init_db(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
    """Apply the migrations this database has not run yet; return how many ran.

    Each script runs in its own transaction together with the update of
    ``user_version``, so a failing script leaves the database at the previous
    version instead of half migrated.
    """
    applied = 0
    for number, script in enumerate(MIGRATIONS, start=1):
        if number <= schema_version(conn):
            continue
        with conn:
            conn.executescript(f"BEGIN;\n{script}\nPRAGMA user_version = {number};\nCOMMIT;")
        applied += 1
    return applied


class Database:
    """Owns the database of one application instance.

    For a file database every request gets its own connection. An in-memory
    database (``":memory:"``) exists only as long as its connection, so in that
    case a single shared connection is kept for the life of the application and
    access to it is serialised with a lock.
    """

    def __init__(self, path: str) -> None:
        self.path = path
        self._shared: sqlite3.Connection | None = None
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        if path == ":memory:":
            self._shared = connect(path)
            init_db(self._shared)
        else:
            with connect(path) as conn:
                init_db(conn)

    def connections(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
        """Yield one connection for a request, committing or rolling back afterwards."""
        if self._shared is not None:
            with self._lock:
                try:
                    yield self._shared
                    self._shared.commit()
                except BaseException:
                    self._shared.rollback()
                    raise
            return
        conn = connect(self.path)
        try:
            yield conn
            conn.commit()
        except BaseException:
            conn.rollback()
            raise
        finally:
            conn.close()


_database: Database | None = None


def configure(database: Database) -> None:
    """Make ``database`` the one :func:`get_db` hands connections from."""
    global _database
    _database = database


def get_db() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
    """FastAPI dependency: a connection for the current request.

    Usage::

        def endpoint(conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)): ...

    Raises:
        RuntimeError: if the application was not created through
            :func:`app.main.create_app`, which configures the database.
    """
    if _database is None:
        raise RuntimeError("database not configured: create the app with create_app()")
    yield from _database.connections()


def audit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, event: str, user_id: int | None = None, detail: str = "") -> None:
    """Record a security-relevant event in ``audit_log``.

    Use short event names such as ``"login"``, ``"login_failed"`` or
    ``"register"``. ``detail`` is free text for humans; never put passwords or
    tokens in it.
    """
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, event, detail, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (user_id, event, detail, utc_now()),
    )


def row_to_dict(row: sqlite3.Row | None) -> dict[str, object] | None:
    """Turn a row into a plain dict (or keep ``None``), e.g. to return it as JSON."""
    return None if row is None else {key: row[key] for key in row.keys()}

"""Authentication endpoints: register, login, current user."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import sqlite3

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.db import get_db, utc_now
from app.errors import bad_request, conflict, unauthorized
from app.security import (
    CurrentUser,
    create_access_token,
    get_current_user,
    hash_password,
    password_problem,
    verify_password,
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/auth", tags=["auth"])

USERNAME_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,32}$")


class RegisterRequest(BaseModel):
    username: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=32)
    password: str


class RegisterResponse(BaseModel):
    id: int
    username: str
    created_at: str


class LoginRequest(BaseModel):
    username: str
    password: str


class LoginResponse(BaseModel):
    access_token: str
    token_type: str = "bearer"
    expires_in: int


class MeResponse(BaseModel):
    id: int
    username: str


@router.post(
    "/register",
    response_model=RegisterResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
    summary="Create a new account",
)
def register(
    data: RegisterRequest,
    conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db),
    settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings),
) -> RegisterResponse:
    """Register a new user.

    Username must be 3-32 characters of letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.
    Password must be at least 8 characters and not only whitespace.
    """
    username = data.username.strip()
    if not USERNAME_PATTERN.fullmatch(username):
        raise bad_request(
            "weak_password",
            "Username must be 3-32 characters: letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.",
        )

    problem = password_problem(data.password)
    if problem:
        raise bad_request("weak_password", problem)

    password_hash = hash_password(data.password)
    created_at = utc_now()

    try:
        cursor = conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (username, password_hash, created_at),
        )
    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:
        raise conflict("username_taken", "This username is already taken.") from exc

    user_id = cursor.lastrowid
    from app.db import audit
    audit(conn, "register", user_id, f"username={username}")

    return RegisterResponse(id=user_id, username=username, created_at=created_at)


@router.post("/login", response_model=LoginResponse, summary="Sign in and get an access token")
def login(
    data: LoginRequest,
    conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db),
    settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings),
) -> LoginResponse:
    """Sign in with username and password.

    Returns an access token on success. Wrong username or password both yield
    the same error to avoid user enumeration.
    """
    username = data.username.strip()
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, username, password_hash FROM users WHERE username = ?", (username,)
    ).fetchone()

    if row is None or not verify_password(data.password, row["password_hash"]):
        from app.db import audit
        audit(conn, "login_failed", None, f"username={username}")
        raise unauthorized("invalid_credentials", "Invalid username or password.")

    from app.db import audit
    audit(conn, "login", row["id"], f"username={username}")

    token = create_access_token(row["id"], row["username"], settings)
    return LoginResponse(access_token=token, expires_in=settings.token_ttl)


@router.get("/me", response_model=MeResponse, summary="Current user")
def me(user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user)) -> MeResponse:
    """Return the signed-in user."""
    return MeResponse(id=user.id, username=user.username)
```

```python"""Todo endpoints: list, create, read, update, delete for the signed-in user."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from typing import Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.db import get_db, utc_now
from app.errors import not_found
from app.pagination import PageParams, page_params, paginate
from app.security import CurrentUser, get_current_user

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/todos", tags=["todos"])


class TodoBase(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=200)
    done: bool = False


class TodoCreate(TodoBase):
    pass


class TodoUpdate(BaseModel):
    title: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    done: Optional[bool] = None


class TodoResponse(TodoBase):
    id: int
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str

    class Config:
        from_attributes = True


class TodoListResponse(BaseModel):
    items: list[TodoResponse]
    total: int
    limit: int
    offset: int


def _todo_row_to_response(row: sqlite3.Row) -> TodoResponse:
    return TodoResponse(
        id=row["id"],
        title=row["title"],
        done=bool(row["done"]),
        created_at=row["created_at"],
        updated_at=row["updated_at"],
    )


@router.get("", response_model=TodoListResponse, summary="List todos")
def list_todos(
    done: Optional[bool] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by done status"),
    page: PageParams = Depends(page_params),
    user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user),
    conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db),
) -> TodoListResponse:
    """Return the user's todos, newest first, with optional filter and paging."""
    conditions = ["user_id = ?"]
    params: list = [user.id]

    if done is not None:
        conditions.append("done = ?")
        params.append(1 if done else 0)

    where_clause = " AND ".join(conditions)

    total_row = conn.execute(
        f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos WHERE {where_clause}", params
    ).fetchone()
    total = total_row[0] if total_row else 0

    rows = conn.execute(
        f"SELECT id, title, done, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE {where_clause} "
        f"ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
        (*params, page.limit, page.offset),
    ).fetchall()

    items = [_todo_row_to_response(row) for row in rows]
    return TodoListResponse(**paginate(items, total, page))


@router.post(
    "", response_model=TodoResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED, summary="Create a todo"
)
def create_todo(
    data: TodoCreate,
    user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user),
    conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db),
) -> TodoResponse:
    """Create a new todo for the signed-in user."""
    now = utc_now()
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO todos (user_id, title, done, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (user.id, data.title.strip(), 1 if data.done else 0, now, now),
    )
    todo_id = cursor.lastrowid
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, done, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    return _todo_row_to_response(row)


@router.get("/{todo_id}", response_model=TodoResponse, summary="Get a todo")
def get_todo(
    todo_id: int,
    user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user),
    conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db),
) -> TodoResponse:
    """Return a single todo belonging to the signed-in user."""
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, done, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?",
        (todo_id, user.id),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        raise not_found("todo_not_found", f"Todo {todo_id} does not exist.")
    return _todo_row_to_response(row)


@router.patch("/{todo_id}", response_model=TodoResponse, summary="Update a todo")
def update_todo(
    todo_id: int,
    data: TodoUpdate,
    user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user),
    conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db),
) -> TodoResponse:
    """Update title and/or done status of a todo belonging to the signed-in user."""
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, done, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?",
        (todo_id, user.id),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        raise not_found("todo_not_found", f"Todo {todo_id} does not exist.")

    title = data.title.strip() if data.title is not None else row["title"]
    done = 1 if data.done else 0 if data.done is not None else row["done"]
    now = utc_now()

    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE todos SET title = ?, done = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (title, done, now, todo_id),
    )

    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, done, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    return _todo_row_to_response(row)


@router.delete("/{todo_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT, summary="Delete a todo")
def delete_todo(
    todo_id: int,
    user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user),
    conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db),
) -> None:
    """Delete a todo belonging to the signed-in user."""
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "DELETE FROM todos WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", (todo_id, user.id)
    )
    if cursor.rowcount == 0:
        raise not_found("todo_not_found", f"Todo {todo_id} does not exist.")

"""The application factory.

``uvicorn --factory app.main:build`` serves an application built from
environment settings. Tests and scripts call :func:`create_app` with explicit
values instead::

    app = create_app(db_path=":memory:", secret="test")

Adding a feature means writing a router module in :mod:`app.routers` and adding
one ``app.include_router(...)`` line below.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles

from app import __version__, errors
from app.config import Settings, get_settings, settings_from_env
from app.db import Database, configure
from app.routers import auth, health, todos

FRONTEND_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "frontend"


def create_app(
    settings: Settings | None = None,
    *,
    db_path: str | None = None,
    secret: str | None = None,
) -> FastAPI:
    """Build a configured application.

    Args:
        settings: Complete settings. Read from the environment when omitted.
        db_path: Shortcut that overrides ``settings.db_path`` (tests use
            ``":memory:"``).
        secret: Shortcut that overrides ``settings.secret``.

    The database is opened and migrated here, so the application is ready to
    serve requests as soon as this returns.
    """
    if settings is None:
        settings = Settings(secret=secret or "") if secret is not None else settings_from_env()
    if db_path is not None or secret is not None:
        settings = Settings(
            db_path=db_path or settings.db_path,
            secret=secret or settings.secret,
            token_ttl=settings.token_ttl,
            cors_origins=settings.cors_origins,
            page_size=settings.page_size,
            max_page_size=settings.max_page_size,
        )
    settings.validate()

    app = FastAPI(title="Taskboard", version=__version__)
    app.dependency_overrides[get_settings] = lambda: settings
    configure(Database(settings.db_path))
    errors.install(app)

    if settings.cors_origins:
        app.add_middleware(
            CORSMiddleware,
            allow_origins=list(settings.cors_origins),
            allow_methods=["GET", "POST", "PATCH", "DELETE"],
            allow_headers=["Authorization", "Content-Type"],
        )

    app.include_router(health.router)
    app.include_router(auth.router)
    app.include_router(todos.router)

    if FRONTEND_DIR.is_dir():
        # Mounted last so that /api routes take precedence over static files.
        app.mount("/", StaticFiles(directory=FRONTEND_DIR, html=True), name="frontend")
    return app


def build() -> FastAPI:
    """Entry point for ``uvicorn --factory app.main:build``: settings from the environment.

    A factory instead of a module-level ``app`` means importing this module
    never needs ``APP_SECRET``, which keeps imports in tests side-effect free.
    """
    return create_app()
```

// Login and registration page logic.

import { apiFetch, saveToken, clearToken, isSignedIn } from "./api.js";
import { el, clear, showMessage, formValues, whileBusy } from "./ui.js";

const loginForm = document.getElementById("login-form");
const registerForm = document.getElementById("register-form");
const registerSection = document.getElementById("register-section");
const showRegister = document.getElementById("show-register");
const showLogin = document.getElementById("show-login");

function showLoginForm() {
  registerSection.hidden = true;
  loginForm.hidden = false;
}

function showRegisterForm() {
  loginForm.hidden = true;
  registerSection.hidden = false;
}

showRegister.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  showRegisterForm();
});

showLogin.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  showLoginForm();
});

loginForm.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  await whileBusy(loginForm, async () => {
    const data = formValues(loginForm);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch("/api/auth/login", {
        method: "POST",
        body: { username: data.username, password: data.password },
      });
      saveToken(response.access_token);
      showMessage("Signed in successfully.", "success");
      window.location.href = "todos.html";
    } catch (error) {
      showMessage(error.message, "error");
    }
  });
});

registerForm.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  await whileBusy(registerForm, async () => {
    const data = formValues(registerForm);
    try {
      await apiFetch("/api/auth/register", {
        method: "POST",
        body: { username: data.username, password: data.password },
      });
      showMessage("Account created. Please sign in.", "success");
      showLoginForm();
      registerForm.reset();
    } catch (error) {
      showMessage(error.message, "error");
    }
  });
});

// If already signed in, go straight to todos
if (isSignedIn()) {
  window.location.href = "todos.html";
}

// Todo list page logic.

import { apiFetch, loadToken, clearToken, isSignedIn, TOKEN_KEY } from "./api.js";
import { el, clear, showMessage, formValues, whileBusy, formatTime } from "./ui.js";

const todoList = document.getElementById("todo-list");
const addForm = document.getElementById("add-form");
const userDisplay = document.getElementById("user-display");
const pager = document.getElementById("pager");
const prevPageBtn = document.getElementById("prev-page");
const nextPageBtn = document.getElementById("next-page");
const pageInfo = document.getElementById("page-info");
const filterAllBtn = document.getElementById("filter-all");
const filterOpenBtn = document.getElementById("filter-open");
const filterDoneBtn = document.getElementById("filter-done");

let currentFilter = null; // null = all, true = done, false = open
let currentPage = 0;
const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

function setActiveFilter(filter) {
  currentFilter = filter;
  currentPage = 0;
  filterAllBtn.classList.toggle("secondary", filter !== null);
  filterOpenBtn.classList.toggle("secondary", filter !== false);
  filterDoneBtn.classList.toggle("secondary", filter !== true);
  filterAllBtn.style.fontWeight = filter === null ? "700" : "400";
  filterOpenBtn.style.fontWeight = filter === false ? "700" : "400";
  filterDoneBtn.style.fontWeight = filter === true ? "700" : "400";
  loadTodos();
}

filterAllBtn.addEventListener("click", () => setActiveFilter(null));
filterOpenBtn.addEventListener("click", () => setActiveFilter(false));
filterDoneBtn.addEventListener("click", () => setActiveFilter(true));

prevPageBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  if (currentPage > 0) {
    currentPage--;
    loadTodos();
  }
});

nextPageBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  currentPage++;
  loadTodos();
});

async function loadTodos() {
  try {
    const query = { limit: PAGE_SIZE, offset: currentPage * PAGE_SIZE };
    if (currentFilter !== null) query.done = currentFilter;
    const response = await apiFetch("/api/todos", { query });
    renderTodos(response.items, response.total);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code === "not_authenticated" || error.code === "invalid_token") {
      clearToken();
      window.location.href = "login.html";
      return;
    }
    showMessage(error.message, "error");
  }
}

function renderTodos(items, total) {
  clear(todoList);
  for (const todo of items) {
    const li = el("li", { class: "list-item" + (todo.done ? " done" : ""), dataset: { id: todo.id } },
      el("input", {
        type: "checkbox",
        checked: todo.done,
        onchange: () => toggleTodo(todo.id, !todo.done),
        "aria-label": "Mark as " + (todo.done ? "open" : "done"),
      }),
      el("span", { class: "grow title" }, todo.title),
      el("button", {
        type: "button",
        class: "secondary",
        onclick: () => renameTodo(todo),
        "aria-label": "Rename",
      }, "Rename"),
      el("button", {
        type: "button",
        class: "secondary danger",
        onclick: () => confirmDelete(todo.id),
        "aria-label": "Delete",
      }, "Delete")
    );
    todoList.appendChild(li);
  }

  const hasPrev = currentPage > 0;
  const hasNext = (currentPage + 1) * PAGE_SIZE < total;
  prevPageBtn.disabled = !hasPrev;
  nextPageBtn.disabled = !hasNext;
  pageInfo.textContent = total === 0
    ? "No todos"
    : `Showing ${currentPage * PAGE_SIZE + 1}–${Math.min((currentPage + 1) * PAGE_SIZE, total)} of ${total}`;
  pager.hidden = total === 0;
}

addForm.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  await whileBusy(addForm, async () => {
    const data = formValues(addForm);
    try {
      await apiFetch("/api/todos", {
        method: "POST",
        body: { title: data.title, done: false },
      });
      addForm.reset();
      loadTodos();
      showMessage("Todo added.", "success");
    } catch (error) {
      showMessage(error.message, "error");
    }
  });
});

async function toggleTodo(id, done) {
  try {
    await apiFetch(`/api/todos/${id}`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: { done },
    });
    loadTodos();
  } catch (error) {
    showMessage(error.message, "error");
    loadTodos(); // revert UI
  }
}

function renameTodo(todo) {
  const newTitle = prompt("Rename todo:", todo.title);
  if (newTitle === null || newTitle.trim() === "" || newTitle.trim() === todo.title) return;
  doRename(todo.id, newTitle.trim());
}

async function doRename(id, title) {
  try {
    await apiFetch(`/api/todos/${id}`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: { title },
    });
    loadTodos();
    showMessage("Todo renamed.", "success");
  } catch (error) {
    showMessage(error.message, "error");
  }
}

function confirmDelete(id) {
  if (confirm("Delete this todo?")) {
    deleteTodo(id);
  }
}

async function deleteTodo(id) {
  try {
    await apiFetch(`/api/todos/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
    loadTodos();
    showMessage("Todo deleted.", "success");
  } catch (error) {
    showMessage(error.message, "error");
  }
}

// Sign out
function setupSignOut() {
  const signOutBtn = document.getElementById("sign-out");
  if (signOutBtn) {
    signOutBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      clearToken();
      window.location.href = "login.html";
    });
  }
}

// Load current user for display
async function loadUser() {
  try {
    const user = await apiFetch("/api/auth/me");
    userDisplay.textContent = user.username;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code === "not_authenticated" || error.code === "invalid_token") {
      clearToken();
      window.location.href = "login.html";
    }
  }
}

// Initialize
if (!isSignedIn()) {
  window.location.href = "login.html";
} else {
  loadUser();
  setupSignOut();
  setActiveFilter(null);
}

    </nav>

  <div id="message" class="message" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></div>

  <main id="app" class="container">
    <section class="card">
      <h1>Welcome</h1>
      <p>Taskboard keeps your personal task lists in one place.</p>
      <p id="health" class="muted">Checking the service...</p>
    </section>
  </main>

  <footer class="footer muted">Taskboard</footer>

  <script type="module">
    import { apiFetch, ApiError } from "./js/api.js";
    import { showMessage, el, clear } from "./js/ui.js";
    import { loadToken, clearToken, isSignedIn, TOKEN_KEY } from "./js/api.js";

    const nav = document.getElementById("nav");

    function renderNav() {
      clear(nav);
      if (isSignedIn()) {
        nav.append(
          el("a", { href: "todos.html" }, "Todos"),
          el("a", { href: "#", id: "sign-out", class: "secondary" }, "Sign out")
        );
        document.getElementById("sign-out").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          clearToken();
          window.location.href = "login.html";
        });
      } else {
        nav.append(
          el("a", { href: "login.html" }, "Sign in")
        );
      }
    }

    // Show that the backend is reachable; a failure here usually means the
    // server is not running or the database cannot be opened.
    try {
      const health = await apiFetch("/api/health");
      document.getElementById("health").textContent =
        `Service is up (version ${health.version}).`;
    } catch (error) {
      const text = error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : "The service cannot be reached.";
      document.getElementById("health").textContent = "";
      showMessage(text, "error");
    }

    renderNav();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
